name: cyberriskguardian-threatintel
description: AI-assisted, scenario-driven cybersecurity risk assessment with dated, traceable threat-intelligence calibration from CISA KEV and FIRST EPSS. Adds the Threat Evidence Ladder, snapshot lifecycle and threat-driven revision log to the CyberRiskGuardian method, and connects to the CyberRiskGuardian Ontology (CRGO 0.10.0) through the dss/v1 data contract (legal applicability, control evidence by assessor line, proposed-only write-backs) and the read-only compliance/v1 and secops/v1 contracts (compliance posture, detection and response readiness). Aligned with the textbook Introduction to Cybersecurity Governance, 3rd ed., v2.51: 19-step workflow, validated calculator, quick scan and label check.
